blocks.text: To edit a certificate for web servers:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Clientless Portal > Certificates.
In the table, locate the certificate you want to modify and click the Edit icon.
In the Edit Certificate window, modify fields as necessary. You can see more details about the certificate, including the common name (CN) and certificate's expiration date.

blocks.text: To replace an expired certificate, you must upload a new one. To learn more, see About (Web Server) Certificates.
